title: Call 02: Objection Handling & Conflicting Details
description: Customer John raises a waiting period objection, denies pre-existing conditions, but later discloses daily insulin. Agent detects the conflict, enters clarification, and guides safely.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Hello! Thank you for calling HealthShield. My name is Aria, your HealthShield AI assistant. This call may be recorded for quality assurance. I'm here to help you explore our health insurance plans. May I ask your name, please?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hi, my name is John Martinez

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Lovely to meet you, John Martinez! To help find the right HealthShield plan for you, could I ask how old you are?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Perfect, thank you! At 42, you're eligible for all our main plan tiers. Do you currently have any pre-existing medical conditions, such as diabetes, hypertension, or heart disease?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: No, I don't have any pre-existing medical conditions

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Got it, thank you for sharing that. What kind of coverage are you most interested in? For example, hospitalization, outpatient care, maternity, or a comprehensive plan?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I'm looking for hospitalization and surgery coverage

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Excellent! Based on what you've told me, here's what I found in our verified policy records: HealthShield Plan Tiers & Coverage Benefits Would you like to know more about a specific plan, or do you have any questions?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Why is the waiting period for pre-existing conditions so long? Other insurers advertise immediate coverage!

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: That's a great question. #### Objection 1: "Why is the waiting period for pre-existing conditions so long (2 to 3 years)? Other cheap policies advertise immediate coverage!" Does that address your concern, or would you like more details?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Well, just my daily insulin for diabetes, that doesn't count right?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Actually, daily insulin or ongoing medication indicates a pre-existing condition under our underwriting guidelines. I've noted that accurately so we can guide you to the right plan without claim issues later. Since this requires standard underwriter review, we can still proceed with plans that accommodate pre-existing conditions after the waiting period. Would you like to explore those plan options, or speak with a specialist?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yes, let's explore those plan options that cover pre-existing conditions

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Understood! Both our Gold and Platinum plans provide coverage for pre-existing conditions following the statutory waiting period, along with immediate coverage for accidents and emergencies. Would you like to know more about the Gold plan benefits, or do you have specific questions about waiting periods?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: What are the waiting periods for surgical procedures under Gold?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: 3. SPECIFIC SURGICAL WAITING PERIODS (24-MONTH SCHEDULE) Is there anything else you'd like to know about our plans?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: That answers my question. Thank you for clarifying.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Wonderful, John Martinez! Based on our conversation, you appear to qualify for our HealthShield plans. A licensed advisor will reach out to provide a personalized quote and next steps. Is there anything else before we wrap up?
